significance: The first golden temple built in Telangana, completed at Banjara Hills in 2018 and inaugurated by Vice-President Venkaiah Naidu, with a five-tiered gilded gopuram, a 50-foot golden flagstaff and a main hall of some 4,600 square feet. It holds four shrines: to Lakshmi Narasimha, to Radha-Govinda, to Shiva as Panchajanyeshwara and to Hanuman as Japa Anjaneya.
story: Devotees hold the Lakshmi Narasimha worshipped here to be swayambhu, self-manifested several centuries ago, making it one of the oldest shrines in Hyderabad.
